In LaTeX, you can left-align the caption of a table without using the `caption` package by redefining the `\@makecaption` command for tables. Here's how you can do it:

### Method 1: Using `\captionsetup` (if you later decide to use `caption` package)
*(Not applicable here, but included for completeness.)*

### Method 2: Redefining `\@makecaption` (No `caption` package)
Add the following code to your preamble (before `\begin{document}`):

```latex
\makeatletter
\long\def\@makecaption#1#2{%
  \vskip\abovecaptionskip
  \sbox\@tempboxa{\textbf{#1:} #2}%  % Left-aligned caption
  \ifdim \wd\@tempboxa >\hsize
    \textbf{#1:} #2\par          % If caption is too long, wrap it
  \else
    \global \@minipagefalse
    \hb@xt@\hsize{\hfil\box\@tempboxa\hfil}%  % Centered by default (modify here)
  \fi
  \vskip\belowcaptionskip}
\makeatother
```

To **left-align** the caption, modify the `\hb@xt@\hsize{\hfil\box\@tempboxa\hfil}` line to remove the `\hfil` on the left:

```latex
\makeatletter
\long\def\@makecaption#1#2{%
  \vskip\abovecaptionskip
  \sbox\@tempboxa{\textbf{#1:} #2}%
  \ifdim \wd\@tempboxa >\hsize
    \textbf{#1:} #2\par
  \else
    \global \@minipagefalse
    \hb@xt@\hsize{\box\@tempboxa\hfil}%  % Left-aligned (only \hfil on the right)
  \fi
  \vskip\belowcaptionskip}
\makeatother
```

### Method 3: Using `\usepackage[singlelinecheck=false]{caption}` (Alternative)
If you later decide to use the `caption` package, you can left-align captions with:

```latex
\usepackage[singlelinecheck=false]{caption}
```

But since you want to avoid the `caption` package, **Method 2** is the way to go.

### Example Usage:
```latex
\documentclass{article}

\makeatletter
\long\def\@makecaption#1#2{%
  \vskip\abovecaptionskip
  \sbox\@tempboxa{\textbf{#1:} #2}%
  \ifdim \wd\@tempboxa >\hsize
    \textbf{#1:} #2\par
  \else
    \global \@minipagefalse
    \hb@xt@\hsize{\box\@tempboxa\hfil}%  % Left-aligned
  \fi
  \vskip\belowcaptionskip}
\makeatother

\begin{document}

\begin{table}[h]
\centering
\begin{tabular}{|c|c|}
\hline
A & B \\ \hline
1 & 2 \\ \hline
\end{tabular}
\caption{This is a left-aligned table caption.}
\end{table}

\end{document}
```

This will left-align the table caption while keeping the table itself centered. Adjust as needed!
